finding: Default generator reserves trigger rows and never places a third nonzero cell on them, so a rival that compacts a 4/7 or 1/8 pair even when the row has extra nonzero cells fits all generated trigger rows.
rival_rule: Find the 4/7 pair in any row, even if the row has additional nonzero cells; move the right member adjacent to the left and preserve unrelated cells.
domain_note: The current validator rejects trigger-colored rows with more than two nonzero cells. That rejection is the distribution gap: generated lessons contain no negative row separating the exact-two condition from the color-pair shortcut.
